evidence: Changes the core consensus monetary type in src/consensus/amount.h from a raw int64_t typedef to a dedicated class.
rationale: Strengthens compile-time safety for consensus monetary amounts by preventing uninitialized values and illegal implicit conversions. Author notes historical bugs this prevents, such as commit 0026b330c4 (assignment from a bool) and commit 890a09b1e4 (mismatched integer size comparison). It is an internal refactoring that hardens types against future bugs rather than addressing a live consensus vulnerability.
